layoutScope: current Spa-Francorchamps layout (2007–present for lap record; WC races at spa circuitId only, excluding Zolder/Nivelles)

elevationDeltaM.note: Rounded from ~102.2 m published elevation change

lapRecord.note: Official F1 race lap record on current layout

raceCountAtCircuit.note: Spa only; Belgian GPs at Zolder/Nivelles excluded

Engine Power.basis: 65.4% of the lap at full throttle by time; 339 km/h top speed

Aero Efficiency.basis: Pirelli downforce 2/5; scored on drag efficiency (65.4% full throttle, 339 km/h)

Braking Stability.basis: Brembo 2025 index 4/5 (5 High-category stops per lap); Pirelli braking 4/5

Tyre Degradation.basis: Pirelli tyre stress 5/5, abrasion 3/5; compounds C1/C3/C4

weather.method: Manual classification of each WC race at spa from race reports (Wikipedia Belgian GP + F1.com + wet-race catalogues). DRY = no meaningful rain effect on race; MIXED = rain affected part of weekend race or drying/changing; WET = race run primarily in rain or red-flagged for rain.
weather.note: Percentages derived from classified event counts via largest-remainder; sum to 100.

driverFit.source: Jolpica ergast fork api.jolpi.ca — circuits/spa results + qualifying
